decisions.reason: The existing message-185 MODIFY already captures the comparison matrix, both selected finishes, selective gold distributions, and full-gold reference; no additional update or removal is required.
The existing message-185 INTRODUCE fully captures both distribution options and the full-gold comparison reference; finish selection remains independently represented by the source Requirement.
Selecting Brushed Metallic and Satin Reflection for comparison does not change the E and L geometry, proportions, or architectural construction rules.
The material-finish comparison does not alter the second V's optical construction, shared design DNA, or right-arm geometry.
The client requests application of finish candidates to the existing wordmark without changing the approved Hero V master geometry.
The finish comparison has no effect on the all-caps wordmark case treatment.
The selected finish candidates and proposed gold placement do not change the second V's established cap-height and peak hierarchy.
Applying champagne gold to the É accent in one distribution option does not change its required literal derivation from the Hero V terminal.
Message 185 requests finish and color-distribution comparisons but does not change the wordmark's selected kerning or spacing rhythm.
The material-finish comparison does not alter the required peak alignment between the É accent and the Hero V.
